تحتكرون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَكِرُونَ (taḥtakirūna) /taħ.ta.ki.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# تُحْتَكَرُونَ (tuḥtakarūna) /tuħ.ta.ka.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
